observations: Photo 0 shows a large metallic automotive component, likely a transmission or gearbox, lying on a paved surface. A circular metal part, possibly a torque converter or flywheel, is placed on top of it. The component has a label with '460' and some text, but it is not legible. The surface is dirty and shows signs of use.

Photo 1 shows a close-up of the internal components of the gearbox, including a central shaft and surrounding gears. The metal is worn and has some discoloration. The label on the component is not visible.
Photo 2 shows the same gearbox from a side angle, with visible oil stains and grime. The component is resting on a concrete surface with a pipe and some debris nearby. The label is not visible.

All photos show the same item from different angles, with no visible branding or model markings on the component itself. The seller's text claims it is an 'OEM G63' Mercedes transmission gearbox, but no such marking is visible in any photo.

claims.claim: Transmissions Gearbox M278 1282 OEM G63, Mercedes transmission gearbox.
claims.evidence: No visible branding or model markings on the gearbox in any photo. The label '460' is present in photo 0 but is not legible. The seller's text claims 'OEM G63', which is not supported by the photos.
No visual evidence of functionality. No test footage, no operation shown. The component appears dirty and used, but this does not confirm or deny functionality.

claims.claim: Tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The gearbox may not be an OEM Mercedes G63 or M278 1282 as claimed.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the label or any visible branding on the gearbox, or a photo of the part number engraved on the housing.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used transmission gearbox, not as an OEM Mercedes part, which would reduce value significantly.

risks.risk: The gearbox may be damaged or non-functional despite the seller's claim.
risks.proof: A video showing the gearbox being tested or a close-up of the internal components to check for wear, cracks, or damage.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, which would reduce value to scrap or parts-only price.

risks.risk: The gearbox may have been used in a vehicle with known issues, affecting its value.
risks.proof: A photo of the vehicle's VIN or a service history document, or a video of the gearbox being installed and tested.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a used unit with unknown history, which reduces value.

proof_requests: A clear photo of the label or any visible branding on the gearbox.
A video showing the gearbox being tested or a close-up of the internal components to check for damage.
A photo of the vehicle's VIN or service history if available.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
